a-vanished-arcadia-being-some-account-of.title: A Vanished Arcadia: Being Some Account of the Jesuits in Paraguay 1607-1767
a-vanished-arcadia-being-some-account-of.creator: Graham, R.B. Cunninghame
a-vanished-arcadia-being-some-account-of.description: 1924\. With a Map. An account of the Christian Commonwealth of the Jesuit Missions between the Parana and Uruguay and an examination of whether the work they did amongst the Indians was beneficial.

arxiv-2012-12908.title: Measuring the topology of reionization with Betti numbers 2020 Measuring the topology of reionization with Betti numbers – A
arxiv-2012-12908.creator: Sambit K. Giri, Garrelt Mellema
arxiv-2012-12908.description: Abstract The distribution of ionised hydrogen during the epoch of reionization (EoR) has a complex morphology. We propose to measure the three-dimensional topology of ionised regions using the Betti numbers. These quantify the topology using the number of components, tunnels and cavities in any given field.

arxiv-2103-16770.title: Constellations with range and IS-categories
arxiv-2103-16770.creator: Victoria Gould, Tim Stokes
arxiv-2103-16770.description: Abstract Constellations are asymmetric generalisations of categories. Although they are not required to possess a notion of range, many natural examples do. These include commonly occurring constellations related to concrete categories (since they model surjective morphisms), and also others arising from quite different sources, including from well-studied classes of semigroups.

arxiv-2112-08047.title: The Universal Specific Merger Rate of Dark Matter Halos
arxiv-2112-08047.creator: Fuyu Dong, Donghai Zhao, Jiaxin Han, Zhaozhou Li, Yipeng Jing, Xiaohu Yang
arxiv-2112-08047.description: Abstract We employ a set of high resolution N-body simulations to study the merger rate of dark matter halos. We define a specific merger rate by normalizing the average number of mergers per halo with the logarithmic mass growth change of the hosts at the time of accretion.

arxiv-2301-08544.title: Multi-Armed Bandits and Quantum Channel Oracles
arxiv-2301-08544.creator: Simon Buchholz, Jonas M. Kübler, Bernhard Schölkopf
arxiv-2301-08544.description: Abstract Multi-armed bandits are one of the theoretical pillars of reinforcement learning. Recently, the investigation of quantum algorithms for multi-armed bandit problems was started, and it was found that a quadratic speedup (in query complexity) is possible when the arms and the randomness of the rewards of the arms can be queried in superposition.

arxiv-2302-10810.title: A Local Machine Learning Approach for Fingerprint-based Indoor Localization Thanks: N. Agah and B. L. Evans were supported by NVIDIA, an affiliate of the 6G@UT Research Center within the Wireless Networking and Communications Group at The University of Texas at Austin.
arxiv-2302-10810.creator: Nora Agah 1 , Brian Evans 2 , Xiao Meng 3 and Haiqing Xu 4
arxiv-2302-10810.description: Abstract Machine learning (ML) solutions to indoor localization problems have become popular in recent years due to high positioning accuracy and low cost of implementation. This paper proposes a novel local nonparametric approach for solving localizations from high-dimensional Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) values.

arxiv-2410-03702.title: A survey of Zarankiewicz problems in geometry
arxiv-2410-03702.creator: Shakhar Smorodinsky
arxiv-2410-03702.description: Abstract One of the central topics in extremal graph theory is the study of the function e ​ x ​ ( n , H ) ex(n,H) , which represents the maximum number of edges a graph with n n vertices can have while avoiding a fixed graph H H as a subgraph.

arxiv-2410-21786.title: Scaling 6G Subscribers with Fewer BS Antennas using Multi-carrier NOMA in Fixed Wireless Access
arxiv-2410-21786.creator: Kamyar Rajabalifardi 1 , Sagnik Bhattacharya 1 , Mehrnaz Afshang 2 , Mohammad Mozaffari 2 , John M. Cioffi 1
arxiv-2410-21786.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kamyar Rajabalifardi 1 , Sagnik Bhattacharya 1 , Mehrnaz Afshang 2 , Mohammad Mozaffari 2 , John M. Cioffi 1. This paper introduces a novel power allocation and subcarrier optimization algorithm tailored for fixed wireless access (FWA) networks operating under low-rank channel conditions, where the number of subscriber antennas far exceeds those at the base station (BS).

arxiv-2502-10508.title: Readout Optimization of Multi-Amplifier Sensing Charge-Coupled Devices for Single-Quantum Measurement
arxiv-2502-10508.creator: Ana M. Botti, Brenda A. Cervantes-Vergara, Claudio R. Chavez, Fernando Chierchie, Alex Drlica-Wagner, Juan Estrada, Guillermo Fernandez Moroni, Stephen Holland, Blas J. Irigoyen Gimenez, Agustin J. Lapi, Edgar Marrufo Villalpando, Miguel Sofo Haro, Javier Tiffenberg, Sho Uemura, Kenneth Lin, Armin K
arxiv-2502-10508.description: Abstract The non-destructive readout capability of the Skipper Charge Coupled Device (CCD) has been demonstrated to reduce the noise limitation of conventional silicon devices to levels that allow single-photon or single-electron counting. The noise reduction is achieved by taking multiple measurements of the charge in each pixel.

arxiv-2507-01172.title: Classical Guitar Duet Separation using GuitarDuets - a Dataset of Real and Synthesized Guitar Recordings
arxiv-2507-01172.description: Abstract Recent advancements in music source separation (MSS) have focused in the multi-timbral case, with existing architectures tailored for the separation of distinct instruments, overlooking thus the challenge of separating instruments with similar timbral characteristics. Addressing this gap, our work focuses on monotimbral MSS, specifically within the context of classical guitar duets.

pmc-10696068.title: Gravitationally induced decoherence vs space-time diffusion: testing the quantum nature of gravity
pmc-10696068.creator: Jonathan Oppenheim, Carlo Sparaciari, Barbara Šoda, Zachary Weller-Davies
pmc-10696068.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We consider two interacting systems when one is treated classically while the other system remains quantum. Consistent dynamics of this coupling has been shown to exist, and explored in the context of treating space-time classically. Here, we prove that any such hybrid dynamics necessarily results in decoherence of the quantum system, and a breakdown in predictability in the classical phase space.

pmc-10997303.title: High quality of diabetes care in Greenland since the launch of Steno Diabetes Center Greenland 2020 - geographical disparities need attention
pmc-10997303.creator: Marie Balslev Backe, Marit Eika Jørgensen, Michael Lynge Pedersen
pmc-10997303.description: The aim of this study was to estimate the prevalence of diagnosed diabetes in Greenland and evaluate quality of care according to sex, region and healthcare unit within regions. Data on all inhabitants registered with diabetes were extracted from the electronic medical record.

pmc-11510541.title: Therapeutic, Clinicopathological, and Molecular Correlates of PRKACA Expression in Gastrointestinal Cancers
pmc-11510541.creator: Ayoub Al Othaim, Glowi Alasiri, Abdulaziz Alfahed, Francesca Musumeci
pmc-11510541.description: Background/Objectives: PRKACA alterations have clear diagnostic and biological roles in the fibrolamellar variant of hepatocellular carcinoma and a potential predictive role in that cancer type. However, the roles of PRKACA have not been comprehensively examined in gastric and colorectal cancers (GC and CRC). This study, therefore, sought to investigate the roles of PRKACA expression in GC and CRC.

pmc-11520397.title: A case report of a rare form of calcium pyrophosphate disease: sacroiliitis with soft tissue involvement mimicking an infectious disease

pmc-11520397.description: abscesses. Dear Editor, We report a 75-year-old man with a known history of calcium pyrophosphate disease for several years located on wrist, elbow and shoulder bilaterally. He was admitted in the rheumatology department of Rennes University Hospital for acute right hip pain. This pain appeared suddenly, a few days before admission to hospital, associated with fever and functional disability.

pmc-12495663.title: Impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on tuberculosis patients’ healthcare-seeking behaviors and doctors’ diagnosis delays
pmc-12495663.creator: Xinling Shi, Zhenpeng Guo, Qiao Liu, Qiang Zhang, Xiaolong Zhang, Qin Wen, Yuting Wang, Jianming Wang
pmc-12495663.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionSince the onset of the Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, global healthcare systems have faced unprecedented challenges. To control the spread of COVID-19, China implemented multiple nonpharmaceutical interventions (NPIs). These measures have significantly altered people’s healthcare-seeking behaviors.

pmc-12595826.title: Health literacy of pregnant women and its association with methyl-group donor intake and folic acid supplementation: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12595826.creator: Ildikó Csölle, Attila Kovács, Szilvia Bokor, Simone Funke, Réka A Vass, Tibor Ertl, Dénes Molnár
pmc-12595826.description: BackgroundAdequate health literacy (HL) can be particularly important among pregnant women, as it can have an impact on maternal and fetal health. Deliberate intake of folate through food and folic acid supplementation (FAs) is essential for women in reproductive age.

pmc-12727182.title: Association between parafunctional behaviors, clinical diagnoses, psychosocial factors and pain widespreadness in Finnish TMD pain patients in tertiary care
pmc-12727182.creator: Arvid Iljin, Ilona Assila, Ritva Näpänkangas, Tuija Teerijoki-Oksa, Mimmi Tolvanen, Kirsi Sipilä
pmc-12727182.description: Background: To evaluate the association of oral parafunctions with clinical DC/TMD (Diagnostic Criteria for Temporomandibular Disorders) Axis I diagnoses, Axis II biopsychosocial assessment and pain widespreadness in TMD pain patients in tertiary care. Methods: 197 TMD pain patients were clinically examined and responded to DC/TMD OBC (Oral Behaviour Checklist) and Axis II comprehensive instruments.

pmc-13422039.title: Ambulance services for road traffic injury (RTI) victims in Bangladesh: a cross-sectional study on the ground realities and the way forward
pmc-13422039.creator: Zarin Tasnim, Samiun Nazrin Bente Kamal Tune, Bushra Zarin Islam, Nahitun Naher, Syed Masud Ahmed
pmc-13422039.description: IntroductionSwift and safe transport of road traffic injury patients for life-saving interventions requires a functioning ambulance system which is largely lacking in the low- and middle-income countries. This study explored the current situation of ambulance-based prehospital care services in Bangladesh to inform the development of an evidence-based national ambulance system.

pmc-13536688.title: The relationship between swamps and malaria: a review of the studies titled The Sanitary and Social Geography of Turkey
pmc-13536688.creator: Cihat Tanış
pmc-13536688.description: This study examines the multidimensional impact of infectious diseases on societies through the case of malaria, with particular emphasis on the anti-malaria campaigns implemented in Türkiye during the early Republican period within the framework of the studies titled The Sanitary and Social Geography of Turkey.
